newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market lightly tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market lightly tested - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area early Friday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady in light test. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 200 slaughter steers and 100 heifers; following weekly movement of 115,600 head.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1200 lbs 66.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1050 lbs 66.00.
